units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y downward; no metric scale
background: uniform dark grey (RGB ~80,81,88), no ground, horizon or markings; no static objects

camera.motion: static (background uniform, corner pixels identical in all frames; no shift measurable or present)
camera.perspective_notes: Rendered with a perspective camera: the plane shows only one engine near image centre (frame 0) but both engines when at the left (frame 20); the car's mask length grows from 91 px to 98 px as it moves from x~899 to x~1624. Motion is horizontal in a plane facing the camera; treat as planar (one scale) unless a question says otherwise.

plane.description: white Air China passenger jet (A320-type airliner, red phoenix logo on tail), side view, nose pointing left; upper object
plane.visible_frames: 0-34 (fully visible 0-18; nose cut by left border from frame 19; only a sliver at 34; gone 35-37)
plane.reference_point: tail-fin centroid + (-260.0 px) offset in every frame (offset = median bbox-centre minus fin-centroid over frames 0-18, where the plane is fully visible); frames 33-34 (fin cut off) extrapolated with the constant step -40.36 px/frame
plane.per_frame_step_px: 0 between frames 0 and 1; then -40.0 to -41.0, mean -40.36 px/frame (constant velocity, no acceleration detectable)
plane.ref_note: bbox centre at frame 0 is 1027.5; the CSV ref uses fin centroid + median offset in every frame for consistency (<=3 px from bbox centre)

car.description: small white angular pickup (Tesla Cybertruck-like), side view, below the plane; lower object
car.per_frame_step_px: 0 between frames 0 and 1; then 19.5-21.0, mean 20.13 px/frame (column-centroid steps 19.7-20.4; constant velocity)

relations.note: objects move in opposite directions and never overlap; horizontal separation grows by ~60.5 px/frame from frame 2 on; per-frame distances follow from the two track CSVs (same frame rows)

events.event: motion start of plane and car (first displacement between frames 1 and 2)
plane nose reaches left image border (first clipped frame)
plane last visible (sliver of tail tip)
car still moving at end of clip
